statement: US Central Command announces at least one new strike that disables, destroys, or seizes an Iranian or Iran-linked vessel, occurring between 2026-09-08 and 2026-10-06.
resolution: TRUE if a CENTCOM or Defense Department statement dated between 2026-09-08 and 2026-10-06 claims a strike on an Iranian or Iran-linked vessel, carried by at least two of AP, Reuters, AFP.
failure_condition: No US strike on an Iranian or Iran-linked vessel occurs inside the window.

statement: A Russian missile or drone strike inside Kyiv city limits occurs between 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-30, after the three-day pause on strikes on the capital lapses.
resolution: TRUE if Ukrainian officials report a Russian strike inside Kyiv city between 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-30 and a Russian-side or Western wire source corroborates the same event.
failure_condition: Kyiv city passes the entire window without a corroborated Russian strike inside its limits.

statement: Russia and Ukraine jointly announce a ceasefire covering the entire line of contact, taking effect between 2026-09-06 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE only if both the Kremlin and the Ukrainian presidency announce a front-wide ceasefire taking effect in the window. Partial, capital-specific, or energy-infrastructure-only pauses do not count.
failure_condition: No front-wide ceasefire is announced by both governments with effect inside the window.

statement: Yemeni government or Saudi-led coalition forces announce the capture of a named district in Houthi-held Hodeidah, al-Jawf, or Saada governorate, between 2026-09-08 and 2026-10-19.
resolution: TRUE if a government or coalition claim of capturing a named district in those three governorates in the window is corroborated by Houthi-aligned media or by Reuters, AFP, or AP.
failure_condition: No named district in those three governorates changes hands by announced capture during the window.

statement: Front-month Brent crude settles at or above 110.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-08 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 96.28 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the ICE Brent front-month official settlement is 110.00 or higher on any trading day in the window. Reference level 96.28 at the 2026-09-04 close.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month settlement in the window prints below 110.00.

statement: Front-month NYMEX WTI settles at or below 85.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-08 and 2026-11-13. Reference: 91.48 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the NYMEX WTI front-month official settlement is 85.00 or lower on any trading day in the window. Reference level 91.48 at the 2026-09-04 close.
failure_condition: Every NYMEX WTI front-month settlement in the window prints above 85.00.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog carries an entry for CVE-2026-19490, the Citrix NetScaler authentication bypass, added between 2026-09-06 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed contains CVE-2026-19490 with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-06 and 2026-11-20 inclusive.
failure_condition: CVE-2026-19490 is absent from the KEV catalog, or carries a dateAdded outside that range.

statement: The AfD wins an absolute majority of seats in the Saxony-Anhalt Landtag in the state election held on 2026-09-06.
resolution: TRUE if the official result published by the Landeswahlleiter of Saxony-Anhalt allocates the AfD more than half of all Landtag seats.
failure_condition: The certified seat allocation gives the AfD half or fewer of the Landtag seats.

statement: The Plymouth County District Attorney publicly announces that Massachusetts will retry Lindsay Clancy, between 2026-09-08 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: TRUE if that office states in the window that it intends to retry Clancy, reported by at least two of AP, Reuters, Boston Globe, WCVB, WBZ.
failure_condition: No retrial decision is announced in the window, or the case instead ends by dismissal or plea.

statement: The USGS earthquake catalog records at least two events of magnitude 7.0 or greater worldwide between 2026-09-08 and 2026-10-19.
resolution: TRUE if a USGS ComCat query bounded by 2026-09-08 and 2026-10-19 returns two or more events of magnitude 7.0 or greater.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog shows fewer than two magnitude 7.0 or greater events in the window.
